newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to tighten tax of self-employed - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to tighten tax of self-employed - paper.

text.p: The Portuguese Finance Ministry is tightening procedures to tax self-employed professional and business people in order to reduce widespread tax evasion, a Lisbon daily reported.
Diario de Noticias said it had learned that tax authorities would investigate tax declarations from professionals that were below minimum levels to be set for each profession.
The newspaper was referring to professionals such as doctors, lawyers, architects and economists, as well as owners of restaurants, bars and shops.
Government officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.
The Socialist government of Prime Minister Antonio Guterres has said it will crack down on rife tax evasion in order to meet economic targets for joining a single European currency.
